vintage.heritage: Wikidata, as cached on the fetch date (see the Almanac's file dates)

rules.text: Every UNESCO World Heritage site with a component in Spain (50, as Wikidata records them), in order of their UNESCO number, roughly the order of inscription. Natural sites are natural wonders.

Every one of Spain's 16 National Parks (Red de Parques Nacionales, OAPN), ranked by the area their declaring law gives them. Spain publishes no downloadable table of park visitors yet, so they are not ranked by visits.
Every cathedral and co-cathedral in Spain that Wikidata records, alphabetically, except those that are part of a World Heritage site (already a wonder).
